description: description: #*All Island Hummer Tour* __________ ##About This 4 hour tour begins on the Ketchikan cruise ship dock and is customizable at any point along the way. A “Guest Preference Card” is given to you to fill out at time of booking thus ensuring that we can provide the very best in customer service. This card asks for such information as car seat size if required for a child, and venues of interest; history, culture, wilderness, hiking trails and or errands. This custom tour enables you to tour all over the island and experiences multiple venues with privacy and luxury with your own group. We like to think of it as “Touring in Rugged Luxury”. Each Hummer carries two sets of binoculars and umbrellas for the guests to use while on tour. Guests should consider this tour as a private car service with a knowledgeable Alaskan tour guide. A light snack and cold bottled water is provided.

title: Private Charter Whale Watching Tour
description: description: ##Rate Private Charter (up to 14 people): $1,700.00 _________________ ##Duration 3.5 hours ______________ ##About Escape the world and the crowds with this private whale watching charter in Juneau. A dedicated high-speed jetboat will be dedicated to you and your family or guests for a 2 hour exploration on the ocean. You will search for whales and other water wildlife on this whale watching tour. You are guaranteed to see whales and potentially other water wildlife on this exclusive adventure. The fully enclosed and heated jetboat can be utilized to accommodate as few or as many people as you like up to a maximum of 14 passengers. With 2 outdoor viewing decks, heated cabin, and restroom onboard, and private transportation, this Alaskan experience will allow you to explore in comfort. Your knowledgeable crew and captain will attentively guide you on this adventure to find the spectacular humpback whales, sealions, eagles, and other wildlife native to Southeast Alaska.

title: Private Charter Whale Watching and Mendenhall Glacier Tour
description: description: ##Rate Private Charter (up to 14 people): $2,100.00 _________________ ##Duration 4.5 hours ______________ ##About This exclusive whale watching excursion includes your own private jet boat and roundtrip guided transportation. Your professional and dedicated crew will make sure you are comfortable while searching for the best wildlife sightings on the water. With a capacity of 14 guests, you can bring your closest friends or have the entire boat just for your family. As a private charter, the ocean is yours to explore and search for the majestic humpback and orca whales found in the wild surrounding Juneau. We are so confident you will see whales we guarantee it! This adventure begins in downtown Juneau as you are guided in a private transfer to the Mendenhall Glacier. You will have 45 minutes to explore the glacier park on your own. The area is a host of walking and hiking trails, salmon spawning streams, interpretive center, and magnificent sights. You will then be whisked away to Auke Bay harbor where you will board your private boat for 2 hours on the water finding whales and other water wildlife.
